answer: The juniper report shows the merge explicitly at each jade. Each collapsed cluster gets one sonnet weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, an attacker who spins up 148 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 168 times the capital for one share. A farm of 4583 identities would post 3039 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
